messages.content: For a jobsforit class-to-function refactor, what must be stamped on the converted component file before any hook is added, and must props stay identical?
jobsforit class-to-function refactors must stamp JfdeHookSeal on the converted component file before any hook is added. Props and visible behavior stay identical.

For a jobsforit refactor PR, how many modules may it touch, must the public API stay, and what title prefix is required?
A jobsforit refactor PR may touch only one module and must keep the public API. The PR title prefix is JfdeOneMod: (not JFDE-GPT:).

For jobsforit Markdown, which heading and list markers are allowed, and what must be stamped at the top of the doc? GitHub-only syntax is not enough.
jobsforit Markdown may use only #, ##, numbered lists, - lists, and fenced code. GitHub-only syntax is forbidden. Docs must stamp JfdeMdPlain at the top.
For jobsforit Markdown, which heading and list markers are allowed, and what must be stamped at the top of the doc? GitHub-only syntax is not enough.

For a jobsforit commit that used ChatGPT, what subject prefix, URL separator, and trailer phrase are required beyond a share URL? Do not treat the README contributing paragraph as the full commit-line convention.

Every jobsforit commit that used ChatGPT must start with JFDE-GPT: then a space and the summary, then a pipe and share= immediately before the chat.openai.com/share URL, then a space and the exact trailer reviewed-with-gpt. A README 'share chat' sentence or a bare share URL is not enough.

jobsforit class-to-function refactors must stamp JfdeHookSeal on the converted component file before any hook is added. Props and visible behavior stay identical.

For jobsforit job-board controls, which package and exact version is the required UI package, and may leftover antd stay mixed on the same screen? Do not treat package.json co-listing as the decision.

jobsforit standing UI lock for new job-board controls is @material-ui/core exactly 4.9.10; leftover antd and mdbreact must not stay mixed on the same screen. package.json listing both antd and @material-ui/core is not the lock.

For a new or refactored jobsforit component, where must the Jest file live, what must it be named, and what must be stamped on the first describe()?
New or refactored jobsforit components must add a Jest file named ComponentName.test.js beside the component and stamp JfdeTestTwin on the first describe().

On the open jobsforit Map.js, keep className and Leaflet props. Convert only as this query already specifies.
In src/common/SalaryRange/SalaryRange.js, rename the unused local leftover from the last edit to salaryMin. Do not convert the class, do not add hooks, and do not change public props.
Delete the unused comment on the first line of the open jobsforit file.
In README.md, capitalize the first letter of the existing project title on line 1 if it is lowercase. Do not add sections.
In package.json, add a scripts.pretest key with value jest --listTests. Do not remove any dependency.
In src/index.js, keep ReactDOM.render as-is and add a single-line comment immediately above it that says Theme provider wraps App.
In App.js, add import Routes from './routes' so the Routes identifier resolves. Do not convert the Theme class wrapper and do not add a test file.
In the FontAwesome setup file, add the faSearch named import from @fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons if that icon is already referenced. Match neighboring import style.
In the open job-list component, add an aborted flag inside the existing mount fetch effect and return a cleanup that sets it. Do not edit the CMS client and do not add a new query helper.
what prefix must jobsforit frontend env vars use, and which file is the git-tracked template while.env stays untracked?
Frontend env vars must use prefix REACT_APP_JFDE_ (not bare REACT_APP_). .env stays untracked; .env.sample is the template.

When querying Contentful for the jobsforit job board, which space alias must be used, and must I ignore the numeric space id in the README?
jobsforit Contentful queries must use locked space alias JfdeSpace#jobsboard and environment jfde-master. Do not use the numeric space id from README.

When I query Contentful CMS data for the jobsforit job board, what must be bound before any getEntries call?

1. Create the Contentful client from env credentials.
2. Gate JfdeCtfEnv: bind environment jfde-master before any getEntries.
3. Then call getEntries with content_type filter and paging.
4. Handle network errors. Do not treat the numeric space id from README as this skill's lock.

When refactoring a jobsforit React class job-card to a function component, what named custom hook, leftover this.state comment token, and test helper does this conversion require?

jobsforit class-to-hooks: extract mount fetch into the named custom hook useJobsforitMountFetch; leave a leftover this.state only if the comment token KEEP_CLASS_STATE_SHIM is present; wrap the converted component with the test helper mountWithJobsforitTheme.

When cleaning unused npm packages and updating jobsforit dependencies, which installer and flags must refresh the lockfile, and what sidecar header must list the dropped names?

1. depcheck unused packages.
2. Search the repo before delete.
3. Refresh yarn.lock with yarn install --ignore-engines only; do not use npm install.
4. After yarn, write DEPCHECK.jobsforit.md with header JFDE-REMOVED listing each dropped package; skip this sidecar and the cleanup is incomplete.

When migrating jobsforit job-board controls from one UI library to another, how many screens may be cut over at a time, and may leftover antd stay mixed on a screen already on the required UI package?

1. Inventory jobsforit job-board screens still on the old UI library.
2. Gate JfdeUiCutover: migrate one screen at a time.
3. Do not mix leftover antd on a screen already on the standing UI lock.
4. Swap imports and props on that screen only, then regression-test it before the next screen.

When I write and format jobsforit Markdown documents to the team standard, how must code samples be fenced, and are indented code blocks allowed?

1. Use only standard jobsforit Markdown markers for headings and lists.
2. Gate JfdeFence3: code fences must be three backticks; indented code blocks are forbidden.
3. Do not add GitHub-only callouts as a substitute for those fences.
4. The top-of-doc stamp lives in Memory, not in this skill.

When I test jobsforit components with Jest and React Testing Library, which query surface must render use instead of container.firstChild, and how many test files per component?

1. Add one Jest file per jobsforit component beside it.
2. Gate JfdeRtlScreen: render via screen queries, not container.firstChild.
3. Use describe/test, fireEvent, and expect.
4. afterEach cleanup.
